Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster puppet parts for an eight-direction RTS Stone-Faced Serpent. Reference image is identity/style reference, not layout to copy. Draw bold clean black ink contours, broad hand-painted turquoise cracked stone plates, deep burgundy flexible seams/underside, coral-pink slit eyes, four translucent cyan dragonfly fins behind the head and two thin antennae. A legless snake, absolutely no limbs. Camera elevated 35 degrees, orthographic game sprite. No photorealism, no busy microtexture, no fog, no labels, no shadows or scenery. Flat solid magenta #ff00ff background for extraction. Canvas wide 2:1, EXACT four equal columns and two equal rows, eight separate centered parts with generous magenta gutters. Top row: (1) normal raised head with short neck and four fins; (2) same head open-jawed venom bite; (3) same head dead, eyelid closed, neck slumped, fins folded; (4) same head petrified gray, eyes dark, stone fins folded. Bottom row: (5) short thick cylindrical turquoise body segment; (6) alternate same-size body segment; (7) tapered pointed tail segment; (8) collapsed dead body segment. Body pieces must be thick and short, no complete coiled body. Each top-row part fills its cell without crossing gutters. Consistent proportions across head poses. All eight pieces face the SAME specified direction, body cylinder long axis along that heading.
DIRECTION: EAST: exact right side profile, nose points horizontally RIGHT. Body axes horizontal.
